title: Parthenolide Alleviates Peritoneal Fibrosis by Blocking Smad2/3 Phosphorylation via Smad Anchor for Receptor Activation.
authors: Zhang, Ying; Wang, Zebin; Li, Liu; Wang, Shuling; Wei, Rong; Deng, Cong; Long, Haibo; Liang, Jianbo; Huang, Ying; Wang, Chun; Peng, Xuan; Di, Hui; Xiao, Long; Xie, Zhiyong
journal: FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小白菊内酯通过阻断SARA-Smad3相互作用缓解腹膜纤维化，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与分子对接，但核心对象非TF-DNA体系，方法仅含分子对接，与课题相关性中等。
abstract: Progressive peritoneal fibrosis is a severe complication of peritoneal dialysis (PD) with a complex pathogenesis. Our previous studies demonstrated that parthenolide (PTL) alleviates peritoneal fibrosis by suppressing the transforming growth factor (TGF)-beta/Smad pathway. Smad anchor for receptor activation (SARA) acts as an adaptor protein for Smad2 and Smad3; however, its role in PD-associated peritoneal fibrosis and the relationship between PTL and SARA remain to be elucidated. In this study, single-cell sequencing (scRNA-seq) data and long-dwell PD fluid samples were collected. PD mice, a TGF-beta1-induced mesothelial-mesenchymal transition (MMT) model, and CRISPR/Cas9-engineered SARA gene (ZFYVE9) knockout MeT-5A cells were established. The results revealed that SARA activates Smad2/3, whereas Smad3 promotes SARA degradation, leading to the downregulation of SARA expression during fibrosis progression in long-term-retained PD fluid samples, PD mice, TGF-beta1-treated MeT-5A cells, and HMrSV5 cells. PTL does not regulate SARA protein stability, but luciferin reporter gene experiments revealed that the transcriptional recovery of the effects of PTL on SARA is consistent with its known antifibrotic effects. PTL was further confirmed to inhibit the SARA-Smad3 interaction through both in vitro and in vivo coimmunoprecipitation experiments. Molecular docking and PTL-biotin pulldown assays confirmed that PTL directly binds to the Smad3-binding interface of SARA at the Pro788 and Ser795 residues. In summary, SARA promotes PD-related peritoneal fibrosis through the phosphorylation of Smad2/3. PTL specifically binds to ZFYVE9 (P788/S795), disrupting the interaction between SARA and Smad3, thereby improving MMT and alleviating peritoneal fibrosis, which in turn restores SARA expression. This study provides a theoretical foundation for the clinical diagnosis and treatment of peritoneal fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 进行性腹膜纤维化是腹膜透析（PD）的一种严重并发症，其发病机制复杂。我们既往研究表明，小白菊内酯（parthenolide, PTL）通过抑制转化生长因子（TGF）-β/Smad通路减轻腹膜纤维化。Smad受体激活锚定蛋白（SARA）作为Smad2和Smad3的衔接蛋白发挥作用；然而，其在PD相关腹膜纤维化中的作用以及PTL与SARA之间的关系仍有待阐明。本研究收集了单细胞测序（scRNA-seq）数据和长期留腹PD液样本，并建立了PD小鼠模型、TGF-β1诱导的间皮-间充质转化（MMT）模型以及CRISPR/Cas9工程化SARA基因（ZFYVE9）敲除的MeT-5A细胞。结果显示，在长期留腹PD液样本、PD小鼠、TGF-β1处理的MeT-5A细胞和HMrSV5细胞中，SARA激活Smad2/3，而Smad3促进SARA降解，导致纤维化进展过程中SARA表达下调。PTL不调节SARA蛋白稳定性，但荧光素酶报告基因实验表明，PTL对SARA的转录恢复效应与其已知的抗纤维化作用一致。通过体外和体内免疫共沉淀实验进一步证实，PTL抑制SARA-Smad3相互作用。分子对接和PTL-生物素下拉实验确认，PTL直接结合SARA的Smad3结合界面，作用于Pro788和Ser795残基。总之，SARA通过Smad2/3磷酸化促进PD相关腹膜纤维化。PTL特异性结合ZFYVE9（P788/S795），破坏SARA与Smad3之间的相互作用，从而改善MMT并减轻腹膜纤维化，进而恢复SARA表达。本研究为腹膜纤维化的临床诊断和治疗提供了理论基础。
